tool_args.rationale: The five rows establish a smooth increasing, concave response over the pilot range, but the candidate mechanisms remain observationally confounded because all other inputs are nearly fixed. An open-branch discriminating probe is the lowest-cost relevant measurement before selecting a quantitative model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating Michaelis/Haldane-style response now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations show increasing concavity but only vary u_now; they do not identify whether the response saturates or combines a power term with other effects.
The observed curve is smooth and monotone-concave, so denser sampling is less valuable than distinguishing the plausible response branches.
It is explicitly irrelevant to the target law and must not be purchased.
